entities.summary: Joseph Fred Naumann is an American Catholic prelate who served as Archbishop of Kansas City in Kansas from 2004 to 2025. He previously served as an auxiliary bishop for the Archdiocese of St. Louis in Missouri from 1997 to 2004.
